item.title: NY weather: Cold weather advisory for Orange County until Thursday morning
item.description: On Thursday at 12:51 a.m. a cold weather advisory was released by the National Weather Service valid between 1 a.m. and 10 a.m. for Orange County.

item.title: NY weather: part of New York placed under a cold weather advisory until Thursday morning
item.description: On Thursday at 12:51 a.m. the National Weather Service issued a cold weather advisory valid between 1 a.m. and 10 a.m. for Putnam, Rockland and Westchester counties.

item.title: NY weather: Cold weather advisory affecting part of New York Friday
item.description: A cold weather advisory was released by the National Weather Service on Thursday at 12:51 a.m. valid for Friday between midnight and 10 a.m. for Putnam, Rockland and Westchester counties.

item.title: NY weather: Cold weather advisory issued for Suffolk County for Friday – negative wind chills
item.description: At 12:51 a.m. on Thursday, the National Weather Service issued a cold weather advisory valid for Friday between midnight and 10 a.m. for Suffolk County.

item.title: NY weather: Winter weather advisory for part of New York until Saturday morning
item.description: At 1:03 a.m. on Thursday, the National Weather Service released a winter weather advisory valid from 10 a.m. until Saturday 10 a.m. for Orleans, Monroe and Wayne counties.

item.title: NY weather: Cold weather advisory for part of New York until Friday morning – extremely cold wind chills
item.description: At 1:08 a.m. on Thursday, the National Weather Service released a cold weather advisory valid from 7 p.m. until Friday 10 a.m. for Niagara, Orleans, Monroe, Wayne, Cayuga, Oswego, Erie, Genesee, Wyoming, Livingston, Ontario, Chautauqua, Cattaraugus and Allegany counties.

item.title: NY weather: Lake effect snow warning in place for Cayuga and Oswego counties until Thursday evening
item.description: The National Weather Service issued a lake effect snow warning at 1:03 a.m. on Thursday in effect until 7 p.m. for Cayuga and Oswego counties.

item.title: NY weather: Cold weather advisory affecting Jefferson and Lewis counties until Friday morning
item.description: On Thursday at 1:08 a.m. a cold weather advisory was issued by the National Weather Service valid from 7 p.m. until Friday 10 a.m. for Jefferson and Lewis counties.

item.title: NY weather: Cold weather advisory affecting part of New York until Friday morning – dangerous wind chills expected
item.description: On Thursday at 1:09 a.m. a cold weather advisory was released by the National Weather Service valid from 7 p.m. until Friday 9 a.m. for Oneida, Yates, Seneca, Cayuga, Onondaga, Schuyler, Chemung, Tompkins, Madison, Cortland, Chenango, Otsego, Tioga, Broome and Delaware counties.

item.title: Dear Annie: My heart loves what my head cannot accept
item.description: He likes movies and video games and watching YouTube; I am a reader and writer and want to discuss the heavily philosophical stuff.
